summary: Completed backend + frontend regression for bank reconciliation focus-loss bug and setup download endpoint. Focus stayed in all six target fields during keyboard.type character-by-character input, reconciliation save path worked, and TEST_FOCUS_UI records were cleaned/verified removed.
action_items: No blocking fixes required in requested scope.
Optional maintainability follow-up: split backend/server.py monolith into smaller modules.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical defect reproduced in requested scope.
backend/server.py remains large (>1200 LOC), which increases regression risk for future changes.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_FOCUS_UI* and TEST_FOCUS_FIX* reconciliation records during tests; all cleaned up and verified removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://scanner-ocr-test.preview.emergentagent.com. Login redirected admin to /secure-admin-control-panel (expected current behavior), then reconciliation flow tested via /reconciliations. Character-by-character keyboard.type focus checks passed for outstanding and collection fields: check_number, amount, and check_date. /api/download/setup returned valid EXE content (magic MZ) and size within expected band around 944131 bytes. No MOCKED APIs used.
rca of the issue: Original focus-loss issue was not reproducible after current fix. Evidence supports that avoiding inline component remounting in reconciliation check editor stabilized input DOM nodes, preserving activeElement across each keystroke.
